headline: A House resolution to censure Rep. Adam Schiff and order an Ethics Committee investigation was tabled and did not pass.
what_it_does: This resolution would have formally censured and condemned Representative Adam Schiff of California for conduct it described as misleading the American people. It would also have directed the House Committee on Ethics to investigate that conduct. On June 14, 2023, the House voted to table it or send it back to committee, so it was not adopted.

who_it_affects.how: He would have received a formal censure from the House and faced an Ethics Committee investigation.
The committee would have been directed to investigate Rep. Schiff's conduct.
